strings.name: Ajay Banga
strings.summary: Born in India, Banga worked in consumer goods and international banking before leading Mastercard and promoting financial inclusion. As World Bank president from 2023, he placed jobs, poverty reduction, climate and private capital on the reform agenda. His career connects payment networks with development finance; project targets must be distinguished from results.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Mastercard and became World Bank president, participating in financial inclusion and development finance.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Economics degree, St Stephen’s College, University of Delhi; postgraduate management programme, IIM Ahmedabad.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Payments and inclusion
strings.highlights.h1.text: Led Mastercard and promoted the creation of its Center for Inclusive Growth.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Development finance reform
strings.highlights.h2.text: Promoted institutional reform and private capital participation at the World Bank.
strings.timeline.t1.title: World Bank presidency
strings.timeline.t1.text: Began a five-year term on 2 June, moving from commercial finance to a multilateral development institution.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Joined General Atlantic
strings.timeline.t2.text: Became vice chairman, continuing his work in investment and corporate management.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Chaired the ICC
strings.timeline.t3.text: Elected International Chamber of Commerce chair, serving until 2022.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Became Mastercard CEO
strings.timeline.t4.text: Led the payments network from July, later becoming executive chairman.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Led Citi Asia Pacific
strings.timeline.t5.text: Became regional CEO and participated in restructuring Asian operations.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Joined Citigroup
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from consumer goods into banking and subsequently held several management posts.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Started at Nestlé
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined as a management trainee, gaining sales, marketing and management experience.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in India
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in Khadki, where his father was stationed, and subsequently educated in India.
